_approach: The Pretoria Bacardi-house lineage that fed into Amapiano: tighter, more syncopated looping than the lush end of the genre, woody rim/clave hits standing in for the 'woody percussion hits' melodigging cites, a compact kick pattern (1 and the 'and' of 3) and minimal swing - Bacardi's own feel is straighter and more insistent than the shuffled private-school pocket. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
